    {"id": 1, "text": "The program shall support a game for three players."},
    {"id": 2, "text": "The program shall decide the players' turn order randomly at the beginning of the game."},
    {"id": 3, "text": "The program shall award a special point to a player when he takes all the cards from the table during his turn."},
    {"id": 4, "text": "The program shall use a deck of 40 cards, divided into four suits (Coins, Cups, Swords, Hearts, and Clubs)."},
    {"id": 5, "text": "Each suit shall have 10 cards, numbered from 1 to 12."},
    {"id": 6, "text": "The program shall determine the primary objective of the game, which is to reach a certain goal."},
    {"id": 7, "text": "The program shall allow players to play multiple rounds until reaching the winning score."},
    {"id": 8, "text": "The program shall shuffle the card deck, then distribute some cards to each player, and finally place four cards on the table."},
    {"id": 9, "text": "The program shall require a player to select a card from his hand during each turn of the game."},
    {"id": 10, "text": "The program shall check if the value of the selected card matches the value of one card on the table, and if so, put both cards on the player's discard pile."},
    {"id": 11, "text": "The program shall check if the value of the selected card matches the value of one card on the table, and if so, put both cards on the player's discard pile."},
    {"id": 12, "text": "The program shall require a player to do something with the selected card if it does not match any card on the table."},
    {"id": 13, "text": "The program shall allow a player to receive three new cards from the deck when he has no cards left on his hand."},
    {"id": 14, "text": "The program shall end the round when all the cards have been distributed to the players, and if there are any cards left on the table, the player who last drew cards shall take them on his discard pile."},
    {"id": 15, "text": "The program shall tally up the points for each player after the round has ended, and end the game if any player reaches the predetermined score."},
    {"id": 16, "text": "The program shall award points to each player based on the following rules: the player with the most cards, the player with the most Coins cards, the player who has the seven of Coins, and the player with the highest sum of their cards."}
